text:
ana (Finance): FYI overnight alert: shared reserved GPUs in us-west2 jumped and a lot of the usage is landing under 'internal-sandbox' instead of the customer project. Dashboard: https://billing.internal/redwood/costs?range=24h&filter=reserved

charge-bot: :loudspeaker: Allocation anomaly detected: reserved-pool 'shared-reserved-2026' - reassign rate >15%. Notifying #finance #eng-platform

leo (FinOps): Preliminary export shows credits from reserved contract RC-789 routed to internal-sandbox-ops project for ~6 hours. Looks like our reservation-share rule matched the sandbox tag. Estimated misattribution ~USD 7,200.

viv (Platform): That matches a recent policy change: we added a fallback routing rule so jobs with missing cost_center get routed to the sandbox project. The rule mis-prioritized business-critical reserved shares. Rolling a rollback now.

ana (Finance): We need to re-attribute the reserved discounts back to the paying customer (acme-inc). Can FinOps recompute cost allocations for the window? We'll need instance ids and reservation IDs used.

leo (FinOps): Plan: 1) identify affected instances from billing export 2) map reservation IDs to customer contracts 3) re-run allocation job to apply reservation discounts to the correct project. Queries I'll run:  
```
SELECT resource.labels.instance_id, reservation_id, project_id
FROM `billing_export.gcp_resource_usage`
WHERE TIMESTAMP(usage_start_time) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
AND reservation_id IS NOT NULL
```
Then re-run allocation pipeline backfill for reservation window. Backfill will update BigQuery tables and the cost UI. ETA ~2 hours once I have the mappings.

priya (Sales): ACME (contract RC-789) flagged unexpected lower credits on their monthly invoice draft. They want the reconciled numbers before we finalize billing. Please notify me when backfill completes so I can share with them.

mike (Legal): Confirm we can change internal allocation bookkeeping. No customer-side resource changes needed since this is internal mapping. Fine to proceed; retain audit trail.

viv (Platform): Rolled back fallback rule at 02:45 UTC. Added guard to prevent reservation shares from routing to projects with prefix 'internal-' unless explicitly whitelisted. PR: https://git.internal/policies/pull/801

leo (FinOps): Started the backfill job: job id backfill-reserve-2912. Will post progress and final delta. Keeping thread open until invoice adjustment is ready.

charge-bot: Backfill job backfill-reserve-2912 succeeded. Delta: reallocated USD 7,183 in reserved credits from internal-sandbox-ops -> acme-inc for window 2026-03-14T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-14T06:00:00Z. Cost UI will reflect within 30m.

ana (Finance): Thanks. Finance will update the invoice draft INV-ACME-MAR and notify Sales. Leaving thread open until the customer ack. :white_check_mark:
